title: Connecting a sales channel or books app
summary: Bring in orders and products from your store, or send invoices to your accounting software.

steps.text: Open {access} from Settings. Celerp Connect adds {website} to bring in orders, products and customers from Shopify and WooCommerce on a schedule.
The same subscription adds {accounting} to push invoices and contacts to QuickBooks or Xero and reconcile the bank feed, so nothing is entered twice.

Once Celerp Connect is active, this page gains a Website tab and an Accounting tab, where you connect a store or books app and choose how often it syncs, and an Online Payments tab, where you connect Stripe so customers can pay your invoices online.

Each connected store or accounting system has its own page with its status, sync now and disconnect. Before the first sync, a preview reads both sides without changing either, so you can check what will happen, set the directions and the date orders are imported from, then start it.
You can also ask the assistant to run a sync now, show what a sync would change, or set which way a connection syncs. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
